summary: Sister of Pietro Petriello and wife of Giuseppantonio Lucadamo; John's 4th-great-grandaunt.
bio: Gaetana Petriello was a daughter of Angiolo Petriello and Lucia Marra and a sister of Pietro Petriello, which makes her John's 4th-great-grandaunt. On 23 February 1855 she married Giuseppantonio Lucadamo, son of Ciriaco Lucadamo and Anna Mastrodonato.
